svg.aria-label: A slice through Worley noise four cells across, one point per cube. On the left, F1, the distance to the nearest point: near 0, dark, where a point lies in or near the slice, lighter toward the seams; on the right, max(1 - F1, 0), what clouds use: a round, bright blob around each point, fainter for points farther off the slice, with dark seams between them.
